newsitem.title: USA: Iridium LLC to sell $750 mln in junk bonds.
newsitem.headline: Iridium LLC to sell $750 mln in junk bonds.

text.p: Iridium LLC is expected to raise $750 million through a 144A private placement of junk bonds via Chase Securities Inc in July, market sources said.
An Iridium spokesman did not immediately return calls.
Iridium will use the proceeds from the offering in addition to a $750 million bank credit facility to buildout its global satellite system, market sources said.

The junk bond offering is expected to consist of two tranches: a $500 million tranche of eight-year senior notes and a $250 million (proceeds) tranche of eight-year senior discount notes, sources added.
Both bonds will be non-callable for four years. The discount notes will pay interest in cash after four years, they said.
The roadshow for the offering is expected to begin next week. The deal is expected to be priced after the July 4 holiday weekend, sources familiar with the transaction said.

Following the completion of the junk bond offering and the finalization of the bank credit facility, Iridium will have sufficient financing to complete the commericial rollout of its service expected in September of 1998, they added.
